1.text: Mwana wanjye, niba wishingiye umuturanyi wawe,Cyangwa ukarahirira ko wishingiye umunyamahanga,

2.text: Uba ufashwe n'indahiro warahiye,Ukaba uboshywe n'amagambo y'ururimi rwawe.

3.text: Noneho mwana wanjye, genza utya kandi wikize,Ubwo waguye mu maboko y'umuturanyi wawe,Genda wicishe bugufi umwinginge.

5.text: Ikize nk'isirabo iva mu maboko y'umuhigi,Nk'inyoni iva mu kuboko k'umutezi.

6.text: Wa munyabute we, sanga ikimonyo,Witegereze uko kigenza kandi ugire ubwenge.

7.text: Ntikigira umutware cyangwa igisonga cyangwa shebuja,

8.text: Ariko gihunika ibiryo byacyo mu cyi,Kandi mu isarura kikishakira ibigitunga.

9.text: Uzasinzira ugeze ryari, wa munyabute we?Uzakanguka ryari?

10.text: Uti “Henga nsinzire gato, nihweture kanzinya,Kandi nipfunyapfunye nsinzire.”

11.text: Nuko ubukene buzakugeraho nk'umwambuzi,N'ubutindi bugutere nk'ingabo.

12.text: Umuntu w'ikiburaburyo, umuntu w'inkozi y'ibibi,Ni we ugendana umunwa ugoreka,

13.text: Akicirana amaso akavugisha ibirenge,Agacisha amarenga intoki ze.

14.text: Umutima we urimo ubugoryi,Ahorana imigambi yo gukora ibibi,Akabiba ibiteranya.

15.text: Ni cyo gituma amakuba ye azamutungura,Azavunika vuba kandi ntazungwa.

16.text: Hariho ibintu bitandatu ndetse birindwi,Uwiteka yanga bimubera ikizira ni ibi:

17.text: Amaso y'ubwibone, ururimi rubeshya,Amaboko avusha amaraso y'utariho urubanza,

18.text: Umutima ugambirira ibibi,Amaguru yihutira kugira urugomo,

20.text: Mwana wanjye, komeza icyo so yagutegetse,Kandi we kureka icyo nyoko yakwigishije.

21.text: Uhore ubikomeje ku mutima wawe,Ubyambare mu ijosi.

22.text: Nugenda bizakuyobora,Nujya kuryama bizakurinda,Kandi nukanguka bizakubwiriza.

23.text: Kuko itegeko ari itabaza,amategeko ari umucyo,Kandi ibihano byo guhugura ari inzira y'ubugingo.

24.text: Byakurinda umugore w'inkozi z'ibibi,No gushyeshya ku ururimi rw'umunyamahangakazi,

25.text: We kwifuza ubwiza bwe mu mutima wawe,Kandi ntukunde ko akwicira ijisho.

26.text: Kuko maraya akenesha umuntu,Agasigara ku gasate k'umutsima,Kandi umugore usambana ahīga ubugingo bw'igiciro cyinshi.

27.text: Mbese umuntu yashyira umuriro mu gituza cye,Imyambaro ye ntishye?

28.text: Cyangwa hari uwabasha gukandagira amakara yaka,Ibirenge bye ntibibabuke?

29.text: Ni ko bimera no ku muntu usanga muka mugenzi we,Kandi umukoraho wese ntazabura kugibwaho igihano.

31.text: Ariko iyo afashwe abiriha karindwi,Agatanga ibyo afite mu rugo rwe byose.

32.text: Usambana n'umugore nta mutima afite,Ugenza atyo aba arimbuye ubugingo bwe.

33.text: Inguma no gukorwa n'isoni ni byo azabona,Kandi umugayo we ntuzahanagurwa.

34.text: Kuko ifuhe ry'umugabo w'umugore ari uburakari bukaze,Kandi ntazamubabarira ku munsi wo guhōra.

35.text: Ntazita ku mpongano,Ntabwo azatuza naho wamuhongera byinshi.
